title: Vintage Hallmark 1975 Date Book Betsey Clark Mini Calendar Unused Plaza Hallmark
conditionDescription: Vintage 1975 pocket date book, unused inside (no writing). Crease across the front cover, toning along the back cover's spine edge, light edge wear.
descriptionText:
Vintage Hallmark 1975 Date Book with Betsey Clark art on the cover - two children at a garden gate with roses and butterflies, signed Betsey Clark in the art.

- Small stapled pocket calendar / date book
- (c) Hallmark Cards, Inc.
- Back cover: "With our compliments... Plaza Hallmark Gifts, Central Plaza Shopping Center, Camarillo, Calif." store giveaway

Condition: unused inside - no writing in the date pages. The covers show age: There is a crease across the front cover, toning along the back cover near the spine, and light wear at the edges (see photos).

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
